import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Create synthetic airline passenger data (since the actual file is a Git LFS pointer)
np.random.seed(42)
months = 144  # 12 years of monthly data
t = np.arange(months)
# Create data with trend and seasonality
trend = 100 + 2 * t
seasonal = 50 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 12)
noise = np.random.normal(0, 20, months)
data = trend + seasonal + noise
data = np.abs(data)  # Ensure positive values

dataset = pandas.DataFrame(data, columns=['Passengers'])
plt.plot(dataset)
plt.title('International Airline Passengers (Synthetic Data)')
plt.xlabel('Month')
